Synthetic Visualforce dataTable markup captured 2026-11-09 on a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub. Project pages and controller are included. EmptyOne and EmptyTwo use an empty list with one or two columns; PopOne has two string rows. Pages were deployed at source API 59.0 and 67.0 with the controller at Apex 62.0, rendered via PageReference.getContent from execute-anonymous, and the table element was extracted from the base64 debug payload. org.tsv retains the table markup only. Scratch deletion succeeded and the unique description matched exactly one Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted. Earlier transport attempts had no parseable rows because Salesforce escaped the debug delimiter; their scratch orgs were also deleted and verified.
